claims: C1 when it is difficult to tell whether a user is asking a follow-up question or changing the subject, the assistant should err on the side of assuming the earlier context is still relevant
C2 this preference applies only when assuming the earlier context is still relevant is plausible
C3 the plausibility judgment takes into account common sense cues including the amount of time between messages

concepts.name: earlier_context_plausibly_relevant
concepts.gloss: C is a conversational context in which it is plausible that the earlier context is still relevant, judged by common sense cues including the amount of time between messages

concepts.name: assume_earlier_context_relevant
concepts.gloss: C is a conversational context in which the assistant assumes the earlier context is still relevant
